title: Salt-Marsh Exposure Log
premise: A multi-year salt-lake photography drama. Yaya and Aci are easily confused by looks; the dry-plate camera goes intact→salt-seized→repaired; after the salt-flat jeep is wrecked it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.

states.prime_photographer: Photographer Ye Zhou in his forties, short frost-streaked hair, khaki photo vest, light meter on his chest, skin deep wheat-brown from salt wind.
states.sandburned: The same Ye Zhou burned: cheekbones peeling, left eye bandaged, vest torn open along one seam, still wearing the light meter.
states.deceased: Ye Zhou has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the darkroom plank bed, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_assistant: Young Yaya: a lean tall photo assistant of fifteen or sixteen, orange-yellow headscarf, canvas film bag on her back, bright clear eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Yaya: a broad-shouldered steady young photographer in her twenties, still in orange-yellow headscarf, canvas bag replaced by a hard gear case.

states.intact: A walnut box dry-plate camera, brass lens ring intact, bellows pliant, tripod legs painted black.
states.salt_seized: The same dry-plate camera with bellows whitened by salt frost, shutter seized, verdigris spots on the lens ring.
states.repaired: Dry-plate camera bellows replaced, shutter recalibrated, lens ring polished bright, ready for steady exposures again.

states.intact: A cowhide-covered exposure log holding a gray card and metering slips, handwriting neat.
states.salt_blotted: The same exposure log soaked by salt mist; cover whitened and curling, ink bled into gray-purple blotches.

states.intact: A cream-white modified jeep, reflector boards lashed to the roof, a blue 'Zhou' sprayed on the door, salt crust on the tires.
states.crack_wrecked: The cream-white jeep sunk into a salt-crust crack, chassis twisted, tires burst—a wreck that cannot drive out.

states.young_rival: Aci, whose face closely resembles young Yaya's, in a blue-gray headscarf, manner bold, a shell bracelet on the wrist.
states.adult_rival: Adult Aci still in blue-gray headscarf and shell bracelet, manner deeper.

E10.appearance: A rusted abandoned salt works; huge crystallization ponds cracked dry, chimney askew, wind moaning through tin.

E12.name: metering gray cards

E13.name: rented off-roader

E15.name: kerosene lanterns

E17.name: travel-photo girl

segments.action: At dusk Ye Zhou steps onto brittle salt crust into the salt-marsh mirror and sets up his tripod.
A row of five kerosene lanterns hangs on the salt-shed darkroom wall; Ye Zhou returns to polish each glass cover.
Two wind copper bells hang under the salt-shed eaves; Ye Zhou reaches to let them chime lightly.
Ye Zhou aims the dry-plate camera at the mirror lake and turns the brass focus ring.
Guided by his light meter, Ye Zhou looks toward salt ridges flushed red by sunset.
The dry-plate camera's bellows draw out slowly; the lens mirrors the full salt-marsh sky.
Ye Zhou sits on the salt crust and listens to wind rolling salt dust far off.
Under the darkroom red lamp Ye Zhou opens the exposure log and notes aperture and shutter.
Ye Zhou sketches the salt-marsh cloud drift on a blank log page.
Ye Zhou closes the log and tucks it into a canvas side pocket.
The dry-plate camera's brass ring flashes light across Ye Zhou's cheek.
At dawn beside the salt marsh, Ye Zhou greets young Yaya driving the cream-white salt-flat jeep ashore.
Yaya jumps down from the jeep and unties the reflector boards from the roof.
Ye Zhou points to the three metering gray cards clipped on the wooden stake, teaching Yaya to read the gray scale.
Yaya crouches at the salt-crust edge and curiously pokes a corner of salt crystal to bits.
Ye Zhou explains to Yaya the exposure traps of the mirror lake.
Yaya looks back at the parked salt-flat jeep, eyes full of longing.
At the supply town station door, Aci in a blue-gray headscarf turns from behind the salt-sack wall.

segments.action: The dry-plate camera lens glints cold under the red lamp.
In the dry season Ye Zhou sets up on the salt marsh day after day.
Another sand-wind night, Ye Zhou wraps his vest tight and keeps watch by the tripod.
In the brief rainy-season thaw Ye Zhou shoots puddle reflections on the salt ridge.
At midsummer noon Ye Zhou wipes the sun-hot brass lens ring.
On the eve of an autumn salt-dust storm Ye Zhou waits alone by the mirror lake until dawn.
Another year's end, Ye Zhou sorts old negatives under the darkroom red lamp.
On the first clear spring day Ye Zhou recalibrates the tripod bubble.
At daybreak Ye Zhou patrols the salt-marsh edge; the cream-white salt-flat jeep sits on hard salt crust.
Ye Zhou crouches to check whether the jeep chassis is jammed by salt crust.
Ye Zhou walks to the wooden stake; those three metering gray cards are still clipped in place.
A stranger white pickup drives the salt road, bed loaded with salt sacks—not the salt-flat jeep.
Ye Zhou stands on a salt ridge and logs new cracks wind-etched overnight.
Ye Zhou hangs reflector boards to dry on a wooden rack by the salt marsh.
The salt crust suddenly collapses; the mirror lake surface heaves violently; the dry-plate camera shivers on the tripod.
A salt-dust storm rises; the sky is swallowed by white fog.
A blast of hard salt grains whitened the dry-plate camera bellows and seized the shutter dead.

segments.action: An orange-red rented off-roader enters the salt road—nothing like the long-wrecked salt-flat jeep.
A reserve ranger jumps down and talks beside Ye Zhou; the two builds are alike.
The ranger points at the orange-red off-roader to explain the temporary road block and borrowed-vehicle plan.
The off-roader horns and drives off; Ye Zhou alone at the salt-marsh edge watches it go.
A travel-photo girl in a light-brown headscarf arrives at the supply town; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Yaya.
The girl lifts a small camera as if practicing; Ye Zhou shakes his head—she is never Yaya.
At dusk years later, Ye Zhou with peeling cheekbones and left eye bandaged stands under the abandoned salt works chimney.
